Provider attempts: (1) CoinGecko api.coingecko.com/api/v3/nfts/redacted-remilio-babies succeeded, floor_price.native_currency=0.158998 ETH, native_currency=ETH. No explicit last_updated field was present in the response. (2) OpenSea v2 api.opensea.io/api/v2/collections/redacted-remilio-babies/stats returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized (no API key available to this session) -- reporting this failure per floorRule fallback. Fallback per definitions.fallback: fetched the OpenSea official collection page https://opensea.io/collection/remilio-babies, which showed the same 0.158998 ETH floor, corroborating the CoinGecko figure from a second allowed source host (opensea.io). Selected floor: CoinGecko floor_price.native_currency = 0.158998 ETH = 158998000000000000 wei, since it is the only fully successful API call and is corroborated by the OpenSea site fallback (0% discrepancy between the two sources actually read). Onchain cross-check: scanned Transfer(address,address,uint256) logs on the contract over the pinned window (blocks 26021228-26028374) via public RPC https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com (chain id and closing block hash 0x91f374936168ab2deaf0bd5b165d5b47fdead879db924e65dbe0df6c2c424643 confirmed): 14 Transfer events found across 9 blocks, top token ids by transfer count 0x1d57, 0x255a, 0x23de. Per definitions.sales, ERC-721 Transfer alone does not prove a sale price; the panel evidence source does not expose per-tx Seaport OrderFulfilled receipts for free, and OpenSea's activity API required the same key that returned 401, so no decoded onchain sale price could be independently attached to a specific tx hash within budget -- this is reported as the exact limitation per definitions.limitations rather than fabricating sale data or substituting a last-sale price for the floor. Command run: node scan.mjs --rpc https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com --from 26021228 --to 26028374 --pin 0x91f374936168ab2deaf0bd5b165d5b47fdead879db924e65dbe0df6c2c424643 --address 0xd3d9ddd0cf0a5f0bfb8f7fceae075df687eaebab --event 'Transfer(address,address,uint256)' --rank topic:3 --by topic:3 --top 3.
